project_type: EdTech platform - Cloudflare Workers edge + FastAPI Python backend + React frontend
build_system: pnpm monorepo with pip for backend. Backend uses pip-compile with hash verification. Edge uses wrangler for CF Workers.
test_framework: pytest with anyio for backend (tests/conftest.py provides AsyncClient fixture), vitest for edge worker
build_command: For backend: pip install -r requirements.txt && python -c 'from app.main import app'. For edge: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge run build
test_command: For backend: pytest apps/backend/tests/ (requires JWT_SECRET and APP_ENV=test). For edge: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge run test
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest from apps/backend with APP_ENV=test and JWT_SECRET set. 2. Run vitest from apps/edge. 3. Verify syntax with python -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open(f).read())' for Python files. 4. Run tsc --noEmit for TypeScript.
setup_instructions: 1. pip install (stripped hashes) from apps/backend/requirements.txt. 2. pnpm install from root for edge/frontend.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. Python 3.11, Node.js 22, Docker available. Backend uses Upstash Redis (HTTP-based), MongoDB Atlas, Azure Search, Vertex AI, Sarvam AI, Razorpay, Resend. Tests mock external services.
contribution_requirements: CI runs ruff linter and mypy type checker on backend. Tests require MongoDB service container in CI. JWT_SECRET must be 32+ chars in production mode.
key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI routers in app/api/v1/, services in app/services/, models use Beanie ODM. Edge: Cloudflare Workers with middleware pipeline (CORS -> JWT -> Turnstile -> Rate Limit -> Proxy). Redis via Upstash HTTP REST API (not TCP). Tests use httpx.AsyncClient with ASGITransport.
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/edge (Cloudflare Worker TS), apps/backend (FastAPI Python with app/api/v1, app/services, app/core, app/db, app/models), frontend/ (React), infra/ (Azure Bicep), .github/workflows/ (CI/CD)
